verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships Visalaw AI, a SaaS product where event-triggered automation rules are a plausible capability, so the axis applies. The only related claim is a generic marketing line about automating workflows. Nothing documents user-defined rules, event triggers, or automatic actions, and the API/OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
